description.value: Skaha Pizza is a stone-baked, artisan thin-crust pizza spot located a few blocks from Skaha Lake in Penticton's Yorkton Plaza. Owner Kyra King, a baker by trade who relocated from Winnipeg, took over this well-loved local restaurant and brings careful attention to dough and fresh ingredients. Cyclists passing through the Skaha Lake corridor will find a broad menu of classic and specialty pizzas, including dedicated vegetarian and vegan options.

address.value: 3450 Skaha Lake Rd, Yorkton Plaza, Penticton, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and provides primary evidence. The site confirms an active artisan pizza restaurant at 3450 Skaha Lake Rd in Penticton's Yorkton Plaza, with phone (236) 422-2230 and online/phone ordering options that confirm takeout. The menu explicitly lists multiple vegetarian pizzas and a vegan cheese swap option; no bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
